name: JAN BROCKMANN
beschreibung: Director for commercials, fiction & documentary. Hamburg-based filmmaker.
about: Jan Brockmann is a Hamburg-based director working across commercials, fiction and documentary formats. His work combines cinematic storytelling, visual precision and a curiosity for real people, subtle humour in strange details and the quiet comedy of everyday life.

impressum.name: Jan Brockmann
impressum.beruf: Freiberuflicher Regisseur, freiberuflich tätig gemäß § 18 EStG, Mitglied der Künstlersozialkasse (KSK)
